pages.name: Blackmar-Diemer Gambit: von Popiel Gambit, Zilbermints Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 gave an h2-h4-h5 route; plan 2 was generic in a position where Black must answer Qb5+, which also hits the b4-bishop. Rewrote both (...Nc6 blocks and guards b4). British spelling.

pages.name: Duthilleuk Gambit, BDG
pages.notes: Plan 1 put White's king on the queenside and called the f-file open; plan 3 had White play dxe4 with no d-pawn able to reach e4; plan 4 gave ...c5 with the knight on c6 blocking it. Rewrote plans 1, 3, 4 around Nxf6+, ...Nxe4 Bxe4 and ...e5 or ...Nb4. British spelling.

pages.name: Duthilleul Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a rook lift Rf3-g3/h3 with the knight on f3 and an open f-file; plan 3 wrote ...0-0. Rewrote both. British spelling.

pages.name: Hodgson Attack, 2...h6
pages.notes: Plan 1 provoked ...g5 with White's bishop still on g5; plan 2 wrote Bxf6 with no knight on f6. Rewrote both. British spelling.

pages.name: Hodgson Attack: 2...f6
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed h4-h5 with the bishop retreating to h4, in front of the pawn. Rewrote it around Bh4/Bf4, e4 or c4 and the light squares ...f6 weakens. British spelling.

pages.name: Hodgson Attack: 2...h6 3.Bh4 c6
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Ne5 with the knight still on g1 and offered a bishop sacrifice on an empty f6; plan 2 wanted to trap the h4-bishop. Rewrote both. British spelling.

pages.name: Kampars Gambit, BDG
pages.notes: Overview said White sacrifices a pawn, though 7.fxe4 has just won it back and the gambit comes after 7...Nxc3 8.bxc3 Bxe4; plan 1 called the f-file open; plan 2 had a rook lift Rf3-h3 with White uncastled. Rewrote the overview and plans 1-3. British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Pawn Game
pages.notes: Plan 2 played Ne5 with the knight still on g1. Rewrote it as Nf3-e5 with f4 and Bd3. British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Pawn Game: Accelerated London System
pages.notes: Overview called the f4-bishop light-squared; plan 1 used a c3-d4-e3 route; plan 2 gave ...Nh5 with the knight on g8. Rewrote the overview and both plans. British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Pawn Game: Chigorin Variation, Alburt Defense
pages.notes: Plan 2 gave Nh4 with the knight on g1 and a g4 push. Rewrote it around Nf3-h4 and f3 with e4. British spelling.
